masthead.title: ISS-45 south east Europe at night
masthead.description: Night-time photograph from the International Space Station of city lights across south-east Europe, beneath the glowing edge of the atmosphere.

geo.title: ISS-46 Suez Canal, Egypt
geo.description: Astronaut photograph from the International Space Station of ships passing through the Suez Canal in Egypt, with desert and farmland on either side.

warfare.title: Thule BMEWS
warfare.description: Four AN/FPS-50 early-warning radar antennas at the Ballistic Missile Early Warning System site at Thule, Greenland, photographed in 1984.

cyber.title: A view of the server room at The National Archives
cyber.description: Racks of servers with green and blue status lights lining an aisle in the server room at The National Archives (UK), photographed in 2011.

about.title: ISS045-E-41171 - View of Earth
about.description: Oblique night-time photograph from the International Space Station over the Red Sea, with city lights in western Saudi Arabia beneath Earth's glowing atmospheric limb.
